title: BATCH verification checkpoint after the S16-S20 cluster, stale-documentation regeneration, and closure of S20-O1

source_identity.working_tree: S21 source edits are uncommitted (this subagent does not commit or push); the gate ran against that working tree on top of c911ca629.

findings_closed.before: The EVP_PKEY_type(OBJ_sn2nid/OBJ_ln2nid) fallback was absent. A legacy origin key (keymgmt == NULL) reaching EVP_PKEY_is_a answered 0 for "rsaEncryption" where the authority answers 1.
findings_closed.after: Implemented the authority's two fallback arms: EVP_PKEY_type(OBJ_sn2nid(name)) then EVP_PKEY_type(OBJ_ln2nid(name)). "rsaEncryption" and "id-ecPublicKey" resolve to their method NIDs; an unknown name still answers NID_undef.
findings_closed.test: evp::pkey::tests::a_method_name_outside_the_table_resolves_through_the_object_lookup (unit path plus a legacy EVP_PKEY_is_a reachability check)

findings_closed.before: a_vector_allocation_round_trips_and_frees_once asserted s[3].coeff[0] == 0 on a freshly OPENSSL_malloc_array'd block. The allocator never zero-initialises; the assertion passed only when the allocator returned fresh zero pages.
findings_closed.after: The test initialises the block through ptr::write_bytes before the first read and keeps the extent/release assertions. Production allocator behaviour is unchanged (authority-identical).
findings_closed.authority: crypto/ml_dsa/ml_dsa_vector.h vector_alloc uses OPENSSL_malloc_array; callers zero explicitly

ownership_before: No ownership change in S21. The name2type fallback writes no allocation. The ml_dsa test only reads an allocation after explicitly initialising it.

unsafe_ops.retained: Unchanged; the two added fallback calls are unsafe FFI calls inside the existing private unsafe fn, each with a SAFETY contract.

boundary: The existing C ABI/accessor boundary (OBJ_sn2nid, OBJ_ln2nid, EVP_PKEY_type). No new unsafe abstraction.

discharged: S20-O1: the evp_pkey_name2type method-table fallback now matches the authority.
retained: S20-O2: stale 'Phase 8'/'unreachable' site comments at some EVP_PKEY sites; only the evp_pkey_name2type comment was corrected in S21.
The S20 ameth/legacy-key repairs remain test-asserted transcriptions with no C-authority differential.

compatibility_delta.behavior: EVP_PKEY_is_a(legacy_key, "rsaEncryption") now answers 1 (authority 1) instead of 0. Unknown names still answer NID_undef.
compatibility_delta.phase2_abi: 11/11 ABI courts pass after the rebuild.
